posts.title: Cheng Man Ch'ing - Tai Chi as swimming through air
posts.description: Cheng Man Ch'ing (1902-1975) was one of the later students of Yang Chengfu (1883-1936), a key figure in the development and codification of Yang style Tai Chi. In 1947 he wrote 'Thirteen treatises on T'ai Chi Chu'an', translated and publisehd by Black Snake Books (California) in 1985. posts.title: Thames Path parkrun, Woolwich
posts.description: I finally made it down to Thames Path parkrun in Woolwich last week, an event that started out in 2023. People meet up before the start by the statues in James Clavell Square by the Woolwich waterfront, where the old Woolwich Arsenal buildings nestle alongside new build flats. posts.title: Bude Sea Pool
posts.description: We finally made it to Bude Sea Pool this week, 88m lengths of beautiful swimming on Summerleaze beach in Cornwall. The pool opened in 1930, dug out next to the beach's rocky cliffs. It is a tidal pool, which means the water is refreshed daily by the sea - though this also means of course that the pool can't be used at high tide when the walls disappear under the sea.
